name: Lý Thái Tổ
role: 6th emperor of Đại Việt; founder of the Lý dynasty

checks.lead: Lý Thái Tổ (chữ Hán: 李太祖, 8 March 974 – 31 March 1028), personal name Lý Công Uẩn (李公蘊), was the founding emperor of the Lý dynasty. He reigned the empire for 18 years, from 1009 until his death in 1028.
